en.summary: The probability of Iran's full airspace closure by July 15 rose to 16% (+6.5%), driven by escalating rhetoric including Iran's threat of "immediate response" to any threats. Diplomatic friction also increased with US officials linking frozen funds to MoU fulfillment.
drivers: Iran threatens "immediate response to any threats" (Abbas Araqchi).
Araqchi tells US to "muzzle its pet" amidst frozen funds dispute.
US links frozen funds release to Tehran fulfilling MoU.
en.why_matters: A full airspace closure would signal severe regional conflict or a major security crisis, impacting global travel, trade, and oil prices.
en.bull_case: Escalating military tensions or a direct confrontation between Iran and its adversaries could force an immediate airspace closure.
en.bear_case: Diplomatic de-escalation, successful negotiations, or a lack of direct military action would prevent a full airspace closure.

zh.title: 伊朗局势紧张，空域风险增
zh.summary: 伊朗7月15日前全面关闭领空的可能性升至16%（+6.5%），主要受伊朗威胁“立即回应”任何威胁的言论驱动。美国官员将冻结资金与谅解备忘录挂钩，也加剧了外交摩擦。
drivers: 伊朗威胁“立即回应任何威胁”（阿巴斯·阿拉格奇）。
阿拉格奇就冻结资金争议对美称“管好你的宠物”。
美国将解冻资金与德黑兰履行谅解备忘录挂钩。
zh.why_matters: 全面领空关闭将预示着严重的地区冲突或重大安全危机，影响全球旅行、贸易和油价。
zh.bull_case: 伊朗与其对手之间军事紧张升级或直接对抗可能迫使立即关闭领空。
zh.bear_case: 外交降级、成功谈判或缺乏直接军事行动将避免全面领空关闭。
